pr_title: Fix first hitobject in osu! hidden mod not getting correct fade applied
pr_comments: The weird part is that the approach circle is not supposed to fade out at all, but I'm not good enough at HD to know how confusing the fade actually is/would be. Maybe this should instead fade out just `circle.CirclePiece`?
That's what `master` does already, doesn't it?

Master:
- Doesn't fade out anything.

This PR:
- Fades out everything.

Stable:
- Fades out only the circle.
Oh the issue is formulated weirdly. Sure.
That wasn't the intention. But maybe we should go with it and see what people say? It feels weird having an approach circle approaching nothing.

To me it feels weird because the approach is hidden way before it touches the circle, making it kinda useless? Again I can't really provide much insight here but the reason for it not hiding in the first place is because players maintain an afterimage of the circle in their mind specifically so they can hit the first note accurately, assuming that the approach is visible.

As it is there's basically no reason to even show anything imo.
Okay, will change it to match stable for now.

issue_context.title: First hitcircle not vanishing with HD
issue_context.body:
When you play Hidden on osu! stable the approach circle of the first object (unless changed in the settings) shows up while the object itself vanishes like all others.
In osu!lazer the object stays visible however.
This could lead to some weird reading situations if the beatmap starts with a stream or burst.

Screenshots:
https://imgur.com/a/Yg8nREW
The first screenshot is what the beginning of the beatmap looks like nomod.
The second one shows how it looks with HD on osu!lazer.
The third one shows how it would look on stable.

osu!lazer version:
2020.306.0
